title: They were red
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Chloe, who wasn't at the dock, asks Wood what color they were. He says white on black; the strip can't do color. She says she asked what color they were, not what the strip did. He says red. The last one. She says then say so.

panels.composition: The seawall, evening. CHLOE with the paperback. WOOD with the pad. BARNABY between.

balloons.text: White on black. The strip can't—

panels.composition: The seawall. The two of them. The bay. In the margin, small, in the display face, the strip says so: RED. The one word of color the strip has ever lettered.
